p.NON-CENTRAL-WALS-FOR-MULTI-PROJECT-REPOS: Non-central WALs for repositories that host more than one project.

p.THE-WAL-FLOW-GIVES-A-PROJECT-SESSION-DUR: `flow:org.vibevm.world/wal` gives a project session-durable state: a living WAL checkpoint plus a cold-resume snapshot, wind-down and resume phrases.

p.THIS-PACKAGE-EXTENDS-THAT-CONVENTION-TO-: This package extends that convention to **specspaces** — sub-projects nested in a host repository but worked on as independent projects.

p.EACH-SPECSPACE-CARRIES-ITS-OWN-STATE-REG: Each specspace carries its own boot contract, WAL, and cold-resume file; a one-file registry (`SPECSPACES.md`) at the host root names them; the session grammar gains an optional specspace name (`RESUME SESSION <name>`, `END SESSION <name>`) that switches a session into a specspace **without loading the host's full boot**.

p.A-BARE-PHRASE-NEVER-WANDERS-INTO-A-SPECS: A **bare** phrase (no name) never wanders into a specspace on its own: it targets the `default` specspace declared in `SPECSPACES.md` if one is set, and otherwise the host project itself.

item.CONTENT-THE-BOOT-SNIPPET: `spec/boot/11-flow-wal-specspaces.md` — the boot snippet: how a session recognises specspace phrases, which project a bare phrase targets, and what it loads (and pointedly does not load) for a specspace session.

item.CONTENT-THE-FULL-PROTOCOL: `spec/flows/wal-specspaces/SPECSPACES-PROTOCOL.md` — the full protocol: the registry format (with the optional default), target resolution, the scoped grammar, the five laws (boot scoping, state locality, one focus, host rules survive, package state stays out), lifecycle, and a re-derive prompt.

p.REQUIRES-THE-WAL-FLOW-AT-AN-EXACT-PIN: Requires `flow:org.vibevm.world/wal` (=1.0.0): specspaces reuse its two-file model rather than redefining it.
